name: zidoo-turns-dsf
note: The network player of #456 starting a 6-channel DSF track (--format dsf), first start after a mount, from the round-4 trace (#512): a probe of the track, then the playing handle from where the probe stopped, taking turns with re-reads of the other 11 files' heads and tails: it sends its track's next read when a re-read is answered. Rate 3.5 and lead 4 s are the player's demand as modelled for #508; the trace's own are those of a CPU too slow for it.
